purpose: Attribute field supply excluding downstream callbacks, on medium all-node only; not formal timing
method: GNU link wrap unchanged engine; invariant x86 TSC elapsed intervals, one-time CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW calibration during warmup. rdtsc fenced; record CPU/wall agreement and original <=5% observer quality gate. Callback exclusion retained.
schedule: 80 recorded queries, balanced randomized sampled/control pairs, fixed seed 0x92873, CPU0, four warmups
quality: unchanged sampled/control median within 5%; complete oracle for every sample; require observed source calls and callbacks; no CPU-share/layout selection if quality fails
source_boundary: source inclusive minus owning/scalar/text/run/admission callbacks; rest is query CPU minus inclusive source; nested invocations avoid double counting
decision: Consider B only with credible dominant source cost and a separately documented layout cost model supporting frozen gain. Otherwise continue common execution path. No gate relaxation.
reason: Previous observer produced 11938 callbacks/query, hence ~24000 thread-CPU clock syscalls; measured observer median overhead 7.3% failed gate. Replace intrusive per-callback clock syscalls, not the gate.
phase_basis: elapsed time; no exact CPU-time claim; require median query CPU/wall agreement within 5% and calibration audit within 1% before architecture attribution
